name: 50-radius-longhand-top
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { height: 56px; margin: 10px 0; border: 2px solid #3366cc; background-color: #cce5ff; font-size: 14px; } .a { border-top-left-radius: 14px; } .b { border-top-right-radius: 24px; } .ab { border-top-left-radius: 6px; border-top-right-radius: 18px; }
html:
左上圆角 14px
右上圆角 24px
左上 6px + 右上 18px
